svg.title: Kinference architecture
svg.desc: Inference requests from four independent tenants (an agent, a production app, a coding harness and a chat widget) arrive at Kinference's traffic gateway, which accepts OpenAI and Anthropic inference APIs. The gateway consults Kinference's controller, where routing, load balancing and a policy engine decide what happens to each request. Classification and rate limiting are in development. The gateway then sends it to one of several vLLM workers running on GPUs, or to an LLM gateway that forwards it to external providers. Kinference reads declarative policies and platform configuration from Kubernetes CRDs, receives KV cache events and metrics from the vLLM workers, and reports per-tenant token metrics and SLOs.
svg.text: Declarative policies that capture every aspect of system behavior
